newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to s/a 24.995 bln stg week to Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to s/a 24.995 bln stg week to Dec 24.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 24.995 billion stg in the week to December 24 from 24.978 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 27.048 billion stg from 26.197 billion the previous week.
Notes and coins in circulation fell to 24.824 billion stg from 24.858 billion on a seasonally adjusted basis while the unadjusted figure was 26.877 billion compared with 26.077 billion.
